messages:
Marta (HW Partnerships): Quick sync — vendor sent a marketplace SKU matrix + spot commitment terms. Need to fold into our cost model before EOW. TL;DR: two SKUs (reserved-heavy and spot-heavy), 12/36 month commit options, and a note about proration on mid-month activations.
Emma (Partnerships): Can you drop the matrix here? I want to check marketplace take rates vs direct invoice.
Marta (HW Partnerships): Pasted the key lines from the vendor csv: 
```
SKU,Type,CommitMonths,BasePrice/hr,SpotPrice/hr,MinReserveUnits,Proration
redw-gpu-a1,reserved,12,2.10,0.40,4,prorate-day
redw-gpu-a1,reserved,36,1.80,0.35,4,prorate-day
redw-gpu-b1,spot-optimized,0,0.00,0.28,0,none
```
Marta (HW Partnerships): They also called out a "grace preemption window" of 90s for spot that reduces billed tokens by 10% if preempted within that window (sounds like marketplace-managed compensation).
Ravi (Finance): Important: we need net price after marketplace fee. Nadia, what's our expected cut on cloud marketplace listings?
Nadia (Marketplace Ops): Marketplace take rate varies by partner and promo — baseline 12% on compute SKUs, additional 3% if we run co-marketing. Use 15% for conservative modeling.
Ravi (Finance): OK, so effective reserved price = base * 1.15. Also need to account for monthly commit amortization and early termination penalties. Do we have ETA on penalty tiers?
Marta (HW Partnerships): Vendor doc says early termination: 20% of remaining commit value if cancelled within first 6 months, sliding down to 5% after month 18. They want a clause for force-majeure carveouts.
Carlos (Infra): From infra perspective, two things: (1) spot preemption pattern — vendor gave historical hourly preemption rate: avg 6%/hr during peak weekdays, 1-2% overnight. (2) SKU equivalence: the reserved SKU has slightly higher vram throttling than dedicated direct instances; perf delta ~5% at long seqs. We should model perf penalty on throughput.
Emma (Partnerships): For the cost model, propose we create three scenarios: conservative (use reserved 12mo + 15% marketplace fee + 5% perf penalty), aggressive (36mo reserved + co-marketing 12% fee + no perf penalty), and spot-first (mix 70% spot, 30% reserved buffer).
Ravi (Finance): Add in proration noise: marketplace bills by day, not by hour. For short test bursts that matters. We'll simulate hourly workload but bill daily — can add a 3-6% rounding overhead in our unit cost.
Marta (HW Partnerships): Also vendor wants usage forecasts to tier discounts after 6 months. They suggested a volume ladder: >5k GPU-hours/month -> 7% rebate, >20k -> 14%. Do we include that?
Ravi (Finance): Yes, model ladder but conservative baseline assume no rebate. Run sensitivity for ladder breakpoints.
Nadia (Marketplace Ops): Note on invoicing: marketplace will issue monthly consolidated invoices; they can attach line-level usage but settlement lag is ~21 days. For cashflow model we should add net 21-day receivable.
Carlos (Infra): One more infra ask: we need a telemetry tag from vendor for preemption and reclaim reasons: two fields at minimum `preempt_reason` and `reclaim_duration_s`. Without those we can't implement graceful fallback routing. Request this in the SOW.
Marta (HW Partnerships): Good call. I'll add that to the SOW and ask legal about the early termination language.
Emma (Partnerships): For product messaging and joint announcement planning — if we accept the 36mo preferred rate we should ask for a marketable commit announcement milestone (e.g., "Redwood partners with Vendor X to offer marketplace reserved GPUs") as part of co-marketing. That affects deal economics (co-marketing credit can offset fees).
Ravi (Finance): Action items for modeling: 1) build 3 scenarios with marketplace fee baked in; 2) include proration and billing lag; 3) model preemption hit to throughput; 4) ladder rebate sensitivity. Deadline: EOW.
Carlos (Infra): I'll add a quick perf delta vector for our benchmark runs: 1) short prompt (64 toks), 2) long prompt (2048 toks) and report tokens/sec.
Marta (HW Partnerships): I'll follow up with vendor to confirm preemption TTL and ask for the telemetry fields. Also negotiating to move proration to hour-based billing for large customers — will keep you posted.
deploy-bot: Reminder: please add the vendor SOW to the contracts channel once signed.
Emma (Partnerships): Thanks all — I'll slot a 30m sync tomorrow if we need to triage model outputs. If anyone has a quick CSV with expected hours for next q, drop it here. :handshake:
